text: エフェクトガードは　せんとうちゅうに　つかうと　みかたの　ポケモンの　のうりょくを　さげられずに　すみます！

structure.jp: せんとうちゅうに　つかうと
structure.en: if you use it during battle

structure.jp: みかたの　ポケモンの　のうりょくを
さげられずに　すみます！

patterns.name: 〜ずにすむ
patterns.span: さげられずに　すみます
patterns.explanation: ずに すむ says you get by without something unwanted happening. さげられずに すみます = 'you get away without having them lowered'.

patterns.name: 〜られる (passive)
patterns.explanation: られ inside the verb turns 'lower' into 'be lowered' by someone else. さげられずに = 'without being lowered'.

patterns.name: 〜と (when/if)
patterns.explanation: と after a plain verb says that whenever that happens, the next thing follows. つかうと = 'if you use it'.
